question: Which of the following countries hosted the 2025 ISSF World Cup in Rifle/Pistol shooting?
solution: The correct answer is __**Germany**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **2025 ISSF World Cup** for Rifle/Pistol shooting will be hosted by **Germany**. The country is known for its consistent contribution to shooting sports and its world-class infrastructure for hosting international tournaments. • The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)** organizes the World Cup events annually to promote competitive shooting sports globally. • Germany has a rich history in shooting sports and frequently hosts international events due to its advanced facilities, skilled organizers, and passionate sports community. • This decision underscores the country's capability to host large-scale global sporting events, aligning with its reputation for precision and excellence in sports administration. • The ISSF World Cup is a significant event in the **Olympic qualification process**, attracting top shooters from across the globe to compete in various rifle and pistol disciplines.
